author: _MadalinDumitru
created_at: SonicWall SSLVPN vulnerability actively exploited in the wild: CVE-2026-19868 allows attackers with valid alternate credentials to bypass SAML authentication and MFA on SonicOS SSLVPN. Affected Gen7 <= 7.3.3-7015 & Gen8 <= 8.2.2-8015; patched in 7.3.4-7013+.

author: hifyai
created_at: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) is exploited in the wild. On RHEL 9, php -v can't confirm the fix: the backport keeps version 8.0.30. Check for package 8.0.30-8.el9_8.1. Upstream fixes: 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12.

author: CrackTechDaily
created_at: Google's November 2026 Android security update fixes critical vulnerabilities, including a remote code execution flaw, CVE-2026-58868, that could allow attacks without user interaction. Update to patch level 2026-11-05 or later.

author: heygalatea
created_at: GPT-6 Cyber finds 948 paths to root: OpenAI spent $1,279 in API credits per working Linux root exploit, and its pipeline made 948 of them.

author: nyuszkoreal
created_at: CrowdStrike researchers demonstrate a kill-switch mechanism for AI security agents, forcing silent disconnections via prompt injection in CTI pipelines.

author: ICHI_Global
created_at: CRITICAL Craft CMS (< 5.11.2): CVE-2026-124427 (CVSS 9.8) auth bypass, anonymous GraphQL reads restricted entries; CVE-2026-124430 (CVSS 8.8) RCE for non-admin CP users via template signing oracle. Patch to 5.11.2.

author: fireball_triada
text: OpenHuman's GitHub advisory describes a route from an incoming channel message to persistent host command execution in the AI agent, without human approval. Rated Critical, suggested CVSS 9.8.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: PoC public: Linksys E5600 auth bypass via mesh_login.cgi lets unauthenticated attackers take full control. CVSS 9.3 critical, no login needed. CVE-2026-121615

author: TheHackersNews
text: CISA adds SonicWall SonicOS MFA bypass flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. CVE-2026-19868 could bypass SAML authentication and MFA using valid alternate credentials.

author: bitpinas
text: Philippines SEC confirms data breach of its online platform users: names, usernames, emails, mobile numbers, birthdates, addresses and Tax Identification Numbers.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-6715 IBM Concert 1.0-3.0.1.1 unauthenticated OS command injection, CVSS 9.8. Exec arbitrary OS commands as root.

author: zoomeyebot
text: CVE-2026-98638: Linux kernel arm64 KVM SVE validation gap, critical vulnerability alert.

author: Khaled865412521
text: Pydantic AI v2.66.0 is mostly a security release: 10 advisories (2 high, 7 medium, 1 low), including web_fetch_tool inflating nested JSON responses before the content limit applied.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: French bank Credit Mutuel Arkea hit by cyberattack via a third-party service provider, with fraudulent transactions potentially worth EUR 118 million ($133M).

author: CyberPulse_aus
text: Microsoft: attackers' AI agent mines GitHub for leaked secrets to get into Entra tenants, once within five minutes. Rotate any secret ever made public.

author: pdnuclei_bot
text: CVE-2026-123158 - critical. SSHole - OpenSSH/musl Password Auth Bypass: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a check. Nuclei template available.

author: chris_uk2026
text: CISA flags an actively exploited Apple flaw reportedly linked to Russian cyberespionage. Despite its 5.5 severity score, experts urge patching and checks for compromise.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical RCE in D-Link DIR-878 (CVE-2026-124560, CVSS 9.8) - PoC Live. Unauthenticated HNAP heap overflow allows remote root execution. Device is EoL with zero patch planned.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-42087 | CVSS 9.6. SQL injection in OpenC3 COSMOS TSDB (v6.7.0 to <7.0.0-rc3). Attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands. Patch: Upgrade to v7.0.0-rc3+

author: SlowMist_Team
text: SlowMist TI Alert: Beware of the 'Cracked TradingView Premium' infostealer promoted since mid-October by X account cryptotrice, with posts passing 300K views.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Hugging Face datasets RCE CVE-2026-57845 (CVSS 8.8) has a public proof-of-concept. The library sees 38M monthly downloads, and no fixed release exists.

author: UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL - Unauthenticated SQL Injection in Craft CMS (CVE-2026-123488). A critical SQL injection flaw in the Craft CMS element search endpoint allows unauthenticated remote attackers to manipulate queries via unsanitized attribute parameters.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-41571 (CVSS 9.4). Note Mark v0.19.2 authentication bypass allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack OIDC user sessions by submitting password "null" to login endpoint. Patch to v0.19.3.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CISA has added critical CVE-2026-111497 to KEV. The out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder can corrupt memory and potentially enable RCE when an app decompresses attacker-controlled Brotli data. Brotli 1.0.3-1.2.0 affected; update to 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Openwave Webtop vulnerability CVE-2026-111793 is exploited in the wild, per JPCERT/CC. Upgrade Webtop Media Transcoder to 1.1.22.0 or later.

author: cvedotnow
text: CRITICAL 9.3 D-Link DIR-878: remote heap overflow in HNAP GetCAPTCHAsetting handler (CVE-2026-124560). Unauthenticated attacker can overflow a heap buffer with a crafted uid value. No patch listed yet.

author: cwspycom
text: Chrome 157 shipped 213 security fixes, 7 critical CVEs: Dawn buffer overflows, WebGL + Core use-after-free. CVE-2026-121250 targets the Extensions component. No exploitation confirmed.

author: sirifu4k1
text: Iris Ohyama confirmed a third-party cloud breach that may have hit up to 7.7 million Iris Plaza customers: names, addresses, phones, emails, DOB and encrypted passwords. Rotate any reused passwords.

author: oliver_ojsec
text: The shai-hulud payload distributed via Ruby package strutil-core surfaced in at least 14 GitHub repos over the weekend, inserted into backdated commits. The payloads contain the agent injection instructions from the Ruby package.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: GitBook said 'AI agents' hit its infrastructure: on 2 November an attacker gained unauthorized access to GitBook, the documentation platform; its post-mortem walks an identity chain.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: UnrealIRCd vulnerability CVE-2026-114713 is exploited in the wild, letting users run IRCOp commands. Hot-patch or upgrade to 6.2.7.1 now.

author: step_security
text: @ethersphere/bee-js version 13.3.0 is compromised. StepSecurity discovered this compromise and reported the package as malicious to npm. Malicious code executes during installation, targeting Swarm Desktop.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-66650 - Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in FreightCo <=1.1.15. CVSS 9.8.

author: 0xF390
text: Supply chain attack targeting blockchain-based decentralized storage through a compromised release of Swarm's official JavaScript SDK, @ethersphere/bee-js 13.3.0 (npm). Installing it triggers malicious code.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-29004 (CVSS 8.1) heap buffer overflow in BusyBox DHCPv6 client (udhcpc6). Network-adjacent attackers can achieve RCE or DoS via crafted DHCPv6 responses.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: A proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2026-97798, a Windows Error Reporting vulnerability, gives a SYSTEM shell. Install the October 2026 update now.

author: AGTPinsights
text: React Server Components has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (GHSA-xqc2-xf4c-x3h3). It lets a remote attacker with no login run arbitrary code on a vulnerable server via a crafted RSC request.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical RCE in Contact Form 7 (CVE-2026-114432, CVSS 9.8). Unauthenticated file upload flaw lets remote attackers upload web shells, 5M+ WordPress sites. Update to >= v6.2.4.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: HYBE says a vendor preview tool on its approval and expense systems leaked staff IDs, passports, bank, card and medical data in Sept and Oct.

author: Derrick37394512
text: Microsoft caught AI agents doing the break-in: attackers used ARTEX to hunt exposed secrets on GitHub; one case went from search to Azure Key Vault theft in five minutes.
